inline_text:
Adds a P1-P19 primitive vocabulary (workstreams/taxonomy/primitives/). The shared building blocks (Trigger, AgentStep, Budget, Handoff, etc.) that both architectures below are built from.

Adds the reference-architectures workstream's supporting structure:
- architectures/single-agent.md, multi-agent.md : the two RA drafts
- contracts/ : the AgentStep boundary and Handoff contracts each primitive-crossing step MUST satisfy
- topologies/ : T1-T6, the multi-agent shapes multi-agent.md routes to
- guidance/ : shared supporting arguments (checklists, loop tiers, anti-patterns, invariants, WG boundaries, references) factored out of the two RAs to avoid duplication

Updates both workstream READMEs so this content is discoverable from the top level, and fixes all cross-references between these files.
